about: Open world: a 2004-era open-world crime game homage (the genre, never the game). A low-poly downtown San Francisco built in three.js, a third-person hero, a radar that is Breakout, mission titles, objective text and a big mission-passed state. Each mission teaches one buying signal and the move that wins it. Example: two missions, Pizza for the Buying Committee (speed) and Tail the Champion (patience). Times in bars at 92 BPM (1 bar = 2.609 s).
